name: NORWEGIAN SEA — REPLENISHMENT GROUP
description: Maud must reach a replenishment rendezvous in the Norwegian Sea. A nuclear attack submarine and maritime patrol aircraft threaten the transit. The destroyer supplies the embarked ASW helicopters; the Norwegian ships retain landing facilities without an assumed NH90 detachment. Escort the auxiliary through rather than pursuing every contact. Real geography and real platform families; the conflict, the deployment and the tactical situation are fiction.

map.anchor_note: World coordinates are nautical miles about this point; one minute of latitude is one mile and longitude is scaled by the cosine of the anchor latitude.
map.chart_note: Natural Earth 1:10m · local projection · no depth data

objectives.text: Escort Maud to the northern rendezvous. Her survival matters more than enemy losses.

forces: NATO: 1 replenishment ship, 1 destroyer, 1 frigate (2 embarked helicopters)  ·  Russia: 1 nuclear attack submarine, 1 patrol aircraft
force_note: Fictional 2027 deployment; established platform fits. Reduced air detachments; no claim of actual readiness or deployment.
